mapper.select: SELECT tt.task_id, task_name, limit_date, ms.status_code, ms.status_name,COUNT(tm.memo_id) as memo_count FROM t_task tt INNER JOIN m_status ms ON tt.status_code = ms.status_code LEFT OUTER JOIN t_memo tm ON tt.task_id = tm.task_id GROUP BY tt.task_id, task_name, limit_date, ms.status_code, ms.status_name ORDER BY tt.task_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_task (task_name, limit_date, status_code ,remarks) VALUES (#{task.taskName}, #{task.limitDate}, #{task.statusCode}, #{task.remarks})
